blocks.text:
The `FileChooserDialog` (deprecated since gtkmm 4.10) and
`FileDialog` (available since gtkmm 4.10) are suitable
for use with "Open" or "Save" menu items.
blocks.zh: `FileChooserDialog`（自 gtkmm 4.10 起已弃用）和 `FileDialog`（自 gtkmm 4.10 起可用）适合用于“打开”或“保存”菜单项。

blocks.text:
Most of the useful member methods for `FileChooserDialog`
are actually in the `Gtk::FileChooser` base class.
blocks.zh: `FileChooserDialog` 的大部分有用的成员函数其实都在其基类 Gtk::FileChooser 中。
